subject: general
question: Some of the earliest works in Tamil, known as Sangam literature, were composed around _________ years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2300 years ago**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangam literature** refers to the earliest known Tamil texts, which are considered the foundation of Tamil culture and heritage. These works date back approximately **2300 years**.
 
• The Sangam era is believed to have existed between the **3rd century BCE to the 3rd century CE**. The term "Sangam" refers to academies or assemblies of Tamil poets and scholars during this period.
 
• Sangam literature consists of **poems and prose** that focus on themes like **love, war, governance, and ethics**. These texts are divided into three categories: **Aham (love and emotion), Puram (war, heroism, and external events), and narrative epics**.
 
• Key works of Sangam literature include **Tolkappiyam** (an ancient Tamil grammar text), **Kuruntokai**, **Akananuru**, **Purananuru**, and **Pattuppāṭṭu**.
 
• The Sangam period is considered a golden age in Tamil history, marking advancements in **literature, trade, governance, and culture**. It is also a testament to the rich linguistic and philosophical traditions of ancient Tamil society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sangam Period Historical Context:**

 
 
• The Sangam period corresponds to the **Iron Age** in South India, during which Tamil civilization flourished.
 
• It was marked by organized kingdoms such as the **Chera, Chola, and Pandya dynasties**, which contributed significantly to Tamil art, literature, and trade.
 
• Trade routes during the Sangam era connected Tamil regions to **Rome, Egypt, and Southeast Asia**, fostering cultural and economic exchanges.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Sangam Literature:**
 
 
• Sangam literature offers insights into the **social structure, economy, and religious practices** of ancient Tamil society.
 
• These texts preserve ancient Tamil grammar, vocabulary, and poetic traditions, serving as a linguistic treasure for modern scholars.
 
• Sangam works also highlight the importance of **nature and human emotions**, reflecting the deep connection between people and their environment.
 
 
 
• **Key Characteristics of Sangam Literature:**
 
 
• Sangam texts are known for their **brevity, imagery, and lyrical beauty**. They often employ metaphors and similes to convey complex emotions.
 
• The literature is divided into **Akam (inner) and Puram (outer) themes**, representing private and public aspects of life.
 
• These works also emphasize ethical values, such as **honesty, bravery, and compassion**, which were revered in Tamil society.
 
 
 
• **Preservation and Study:**
 
 
• Sangam literature has been preserved through palm-leaf manuscripts and oral traditions. Modern scholars have studied these texts to reconstruct ancient Tamil history.
 
• The Tamil Nadu government and academic institutions have undertaken efforts to **digitize and translate Sangam texts** for global accessibility.
 
• These texts are celebrated annually during **Tamil Literature Day**, promoting awareness of Tamil heritage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **2300 years ago** is a widely accepted timeline for the Sangam period based on archaeological evidence and cross-references from ancient texts like **Ashokan inscriptions**.
 
• The Sangam period is distinct from later Tamil literature, such as the **Bhakti movement** poetry and epics like **Kamba Ramayanam**.
 
• Sangam works have influenced classical Tamil art forms like **Bharatanatyam**, folk music, and temple architecture.
 
• UNESCO has recognized Tamil as one of the **oldest surviving classical languages**, with Sangam literature as its primary evidence.
